name: Official MCP Registry
description: The authoritative registry for publicly available MCP servers.
descriptionZh: 公开可用 MCP 服务器的权威注册中心。
keyFact: The official MCP Registry, live at registry.modelcontextprotocol.io since its preview on 8 September 2025, is a metaregistry that stores server.json metadata rather than code; it validates namespace ownership via reverse-DNS or GitHub OIDC and exposes a REST API such as GET /v0/servers.
keyFactZh: 官方 MCP Registry 自 2025 年 9 月 8 日 preview 起在 registry.modelcontextprotocol.io 上线，是一个只存 server.json 元数据、不托管代码的元注册中心；它通过反向 DNS 或 GitHub OIDC 校验命名空间归属，并暴露 GET /v0/servers 等 REST API。
caveat: GitHub reports the repository license as NOASSERTION; the exact SPDX license could not be confirmed at verification time.
caveatZh: GitHub 将该仓库的许可证标为 NOASSERTION；核验时未能确认其确切 SPDX 许可。
